programme.desc: It's Teletubby Circus time! Tinky Winky balances on the tight rope, Dipsy juggles, Laa­Laa flies on the trapeze and Po is a funny clown.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: After three years of wandering, legendary swordsman Li Xun Huan returns home, hoping for a peaceful life. Instead, countless fighters seek to kill him for fame. As chaos spreads, Li reunites with his estranged friend Ah Fei and joins forces with him to battle the deadly Money Clan, a rising threat determined to dominate the martial world.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan's fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from “Fake Ghost Catchers” Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Ten years ago, the ambitious Lord Conqueror sought a prophecy from the Mystic Soothsayer. Told that only two boys named “Wind” and “Cloud” could help him dominate the martial world, he took them as disciples. Though his ambition is fulfilled, the prophecy takes an unexpected turn, unleashing a catastrophe that changes the jianghu forever.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Hidden Heroine

Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: After his father's death, the impoverished Kwan moves to the provincial capital and works at a textile workshop run by his late father's friend, retired martial artist Tuen. As a ruthless Manchu warlord exploits martial arts tournaments to expand his criminal influence, Kwan and his allies become entangled in a dangerous fight for justice.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gang's conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nation's honour.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a “Phantom Bullet” that kills without a trace. Detective Song Dong Lu and sharpshooter Guo Zhui are tasked with solving the case. As they uncover layers of corruption and conspiracy, they are drawn into a deadly game where the truth is more dangerous than the bullets.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: Ex-special forces operative Lung infiltrates a lawless cross-border crime compound after his reporter daughter, On Sum, goes missing while investigating it. When he discovers she is caught in a larger conspiracy, an enraged Lung fights his way through the criminal forces, determined to expose the mastermind behind it all.

The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire

As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood

Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Thatch My Idol The Monster Catche
programme.desc: Thatch My Idol ‐ Casper has really had enough of seeing Thatch bully his friends so he sprays him with a perfume he found in his uncles’ magic ointment box. This perfume is supposed to turn the one who wears it into the loveliest person in the world…but actually it just makes OTHERS think you’re great, whilst not actually changing the person it’s been sprayed on! Thatch becomes more unbearable than ever as the kids at Scare School start to treat him like the biggest hero ever, totally putting hi

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Chore Score Dew Drop Swap
programme.desc: On Harper’s first allowance day, the pets accidentally knock Harper’s Piggy Bank over and lose one of her quarters that she was reserving to buy Nicholas an ice cream cone. Now the Dew Drops must scramble to replace it! When the Dew Drops struggle to help their kids with tasks that are outside their usual fairy-bilities, they decide to swap kids for the day, but ultimately learn they’ re exactly where they need to be because they know their families so well!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Full House Gift Express
programme.desc: Nicholas keeps stuffing oversized objects inside Eden’s fairy home. But it creates a BIG problem when Harper’s family wants to visit grandma and the car keys are nowhere to be found! When Harper gets sick, Marcus builds a pulley between their apartments to send Harper treats. But when Qwak, the chipmunk, breaks the pulley, the Dews must step in to keep the treat train running.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Salty and Sweet Cruz Blues
programme.desc: Chef J tells Ollie he cooks with love. Kelp and Ollie set out to make food with love for him. When various food combos fail, Ollie considers giving up, because it isn’t good enough. Kelp goes to his Dad for answers, and two seemingly different ingredients form something magical. When Cruz is not his usual upbeat self, Kelp tries various ways to cheer him up before realizing the best way to be a good friend is to just sit with him, and let him feel what he’s feeling.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Pet Sitters Narwhalicorn Day
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop pet-sit Crabby, who acts out until they realize he’s missing home. Kelp feels like he can’t choose between a celebration on land or under the sea. So he attempts to do both... at the same time!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Boo to You
programme.desc: Burple gets spooked by the legend of a ghost called the Phantom Fang. But when he senses the story is real, he can't get his friends to believe him.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - It's Purrsday!
programme.desc: It's Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Hippo Lake
programme.desc: When Gloria sneaks into the NY Ballet to audition for “Swan Lake” and gets rejected (not for her dancing, but because she’s a hippo), Gloria’s belief in herself is tested.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Best Fans Forever
programme.desc: The gang heads to “Best Fans Day” at NY’s Giraffe Stadium, where Alex gets caught up in the attention of rooting for the winning team. When his behavior ends up hurting Marty’s feelings, Alex comes to learn that the only team that matters is the one that’s made up of his friends.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Egg's Day Out The Way of the Snake
programme.desc: Archibald takes care of a lost egg for the day. But when the egg starts to crack, Archibald has to get the egg back to its parents. After Archibald’s arms fall asleep, he joins a dojo ran by snakes and embraces a life without appendages.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Castles and Caves
programme.desc: Archibald and his siblings embark on a quest in a Castles and Caves adventure game. As the Strutters delve into the fantasy realm, they realize that Archibald’s unusual choices will make the quest even more challenging. Archibald and his siblings continue on their Castles and Caves adventure game. When they face off against the witch, they have to trust Archibald’s unique approach to hopefully win the game.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Stink of Fear: Chapter Three
programme.desc: When Bullwinkle remembers he forgot the secret ingredient to his stinky pie recipe, he and Rocky travel to Norway and enlist the help of his beloved Grandwinkle, not knowing that they are being followed!

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Stink of Fear: Chapter Four
programme.desc: Director Peachfuzz recruits Rocky and Bullwinkle to help her infiltrate Fearless Leader’s hideout, and Boris and Natasha are replaced by a robot henchman

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Enter The Fanaloka
programme.desc: The evil genius Karl sets out to destroy King Julien. When both Clover and Maurice are captured, King Julien must save them from his new nemesis.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Empty Is The Head
programme.desc: Exhausted from settling his subjects' disputes, King Julien replaces himself with a dummy king so he can play hooky, unwittingly sparking a rebellion.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - It's A Secret Queen Of Thighs
programme.desc: Oh cannot keep a secret when Tip tells him she's planning a surprise partyLucy's “Queen of Thighs” video goes viral and turns her into a celebrity.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Krunkle Krush Beauty Tip
programme.desc: Tip spies on Oh when he has his first date with a strange Boov named Krunkle.Tip competes against rival Pom Pom Pappernacky in a beauty pageant.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Lost City
programme.desc: With a map from the comic book, Po and Blade make the treacherous journey through the desert to the lost city, and once inside they find the guardian of the fire whip, Rukhmini. The mysterious figure, a stag named Colin, forges an uneasy alliance with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Last Guardian
programme.desc: In order to earn the fire whip, Po and Blade have to get themselves and Rukhmini out of a lost city with no exits, but Rukhimi’s not exactly who she says she is. Our villains’ alliance shatters when Colin realizes the weasels are mages with magical powers, and he leaves Klaus gravely injured.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - A Thread In The Dark
programme.desc: Klaus is injured and Veruca’s mage powers are not working, stifled by her time in prison. They encounter a dangerous village and Veruca reconnects with her abilities in time to save Klaus, but the two are soon captured by Po and Blade, who are unaware of Veruca’s rekindled powers.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - The Cantaplum Run
programme.desc: Phil enlists the Croods to help him retrieve a rare fruit before some wild animals can. But when Grug doesn't trust Phil's methods of getting it back to the farm, the Croods and Bettermans compete with each other more than with they did with the animals.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Flush to Judgment
programme.desc: When the parents find their precious outhouse destroyed, they perform a "trouble trial" to find the culprit. To prove their innocence, each kid provides their own explanation for the outhouse's destruction.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Caveheart Part I
programme.desc: After a big argument between the Croods and Bettermans, the parents decide to separate the two families. Not wanting to split up, the kids try to convince the parents to make up before the Croods move off the farm entirely.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - That's a Moray
programme.desc: When the team learns of several robberies in Mexico City that resemble the attack on the agency. Ms. Nowhere puts the pieces together and realizes who set them up: an ex-operative she used to work with named Moray. Now, she and the crew must infiltrate a masquerade ball to come face to face with Moray and figure out what he's up to.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Siege
programme.desc: Moray attacks the hauler with an EMP sending it into emergency lockdown and trapping the team inside. Now, it’s up to Roscoe, the only one small enough to fit through a vent, to find help. Meanwhile, Palindrome hunts down Moray using the evidence gathered by Ms. Nowhere.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Into the Labyrinth
programme.desc: In order to stop Moray's plan of directing a lava flow through Mexico City, the team must navigate through the underground tunnels and find his secret lair. But first they have to get their cars back from the DMV! Once they accomplish that, they learn that tunnels are much more complicated than they appear and Tony makes the ultimate sacrifice in order to help them stop Moray in time.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Not Lout
programme.desc: When Snotlout screws up a mission, he must learn to be a leader and earn the trust of the other riders.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Saving Shattermaster
programme.desc: When Mala and the Defenders of the Wing find a mysterious stranger who looks suspiciously like Dagur, Hiccup and Heather go to investigate.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Dire Straits
programme.desc: Viggo gets angry at the dragon riders continually interfering with his business and uses a deep sea dragon, the Submaripper, to control Berk's trade.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Disturbing Dilemma of the Dysfunctional Doppelgangers
programme.desc: The crew meets their blue-hued doppelgängers when they crash-land on an alien planet where kids call all the shots.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Confusing Crisis of the Conniving Captive
programme.desc: Melvin isn't exactly their friend ... but it's not like George and Harold can just let him be held captive by diabolical Biglyans, right? Right?!?

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Aggravated Assault of the Alien Armada
programme.desc: Oh, the indignity: George and Harold are forced to perform spa treatments on gigantic Biglyans. Also, Dr. Fitzgibbons reveals a shocking secret.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Biscuits Rising
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Moon Shot
programme.desc: Our team’s startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a “Space Race”, competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend “moon landing” for a baby – a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Inner Children
programme.desc: JJ reluctantly lets Tina take over her assistant duties for the day, but a Tina slip-up leads to an outbreak of town adults drinking diluted special formula that makes them all baby-brained. When JJ discovers this, she works with R &amp; D Baby Simmons and Security Baby Katja to antidote the wobbling “Adult Babies” before Tina can find out and blame herself.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Escape Artist
programme.desc: Soon-to-be-big sister Lucky “borrows” Snips for a day to see what it’s like to have a little sibling, but nothing goes as planned

programme.desc: The frontier gets a chill when Lucky, Spirit and the PALs attempt to rescue a missing girl

programme.desc: Ipswich Town's first Brazilian, 22-year-old striker Emersonn, opens up on a fairytale arrival at Portman Road, reflecting on a goalscoring debut and an ambitious target that he's set himself. From rural coffee farms to a game-changing injury, he reveals the faith, family and fierce work behind his rapid rise to the Premier League.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP12
programme.desc: Marc Guehi arrived at Manchester City as an FA Cup winner with Crystal Palace before winning the same trophy with his new club 12 months later. The centre-back sits down with The Big Interview to talk about becoming a key figure in Enzo Maresca's team, as well as how a love for music has formed a key part of his life.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP13
programme.desc: Alan Shearer reflects on a childhood where his eye for goal came naturally, and led to a career that ended with him setting a Premier League goalscoring record that remains unchallenged. The former Southampton, Blackburn and Newcastle man explains what makes a great striker, and reveals a piece of advice that he's passed on to a Premier League star of today

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP22
programme.desc: We head to Chile to catch up with former Newcastle United captain Fabricio Coloccini, where he is forging a new path in coaching. He reflects on life in the dugout and looks back on an unforgettable Premier League career that made him a cult hero on Tyneside.

programme.title: CLASSIC MATCH - NEW v ARS
programme.desc: We delve into the Premier League archive to bring you a Classic Match from the 20102011 season.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP9
programme.desc: From fearless forward to one of English football's most inspirational figures, this is the story of Kevin Keegan. We chart his remarkable playing career with Liverpool, Hamburg and England before exploring his impact as a manager, where he inspired Newcastle United to become one of the Premier League's most captivating teams. Through triumphs, setbacks and an unwavering passion for the game, we celebrate the life and legacy of a true football icon.

programme.title: REVIEW - MW10 - EP10
programme.desc: An extensive recap of Matchweek 10, showcasing the thrills, spills and major talking points from each Premier League fixture.

programme.title: ATP Tour 2026 - Almaty Open (250) Final
programme.desc: The Almaty Open is an ATP 250 tournament held on indoor hard courts at the Almaty Arena in Kazakhstan’s largest city. The tournament debuted in 2020 and 2021 as the Astana Open before cementing its permanent spot on the ATP Calendar. From 2024, it moved to Almaty.

programme.title: ATP Tour 2026 - BNP Paribas Fortis European Open (250) Final
programme.desc: The European Open is part of the ATP World Tour and is the largest and only tennis tournament of this level in Belgium. First held in 2016, the tournament was held in Antwerp at the Lotto Arena until 2024. However, from 2025, it has relocated to Brussels and is played at the Brussels Expo.

programme.title: FAGE WTA Finals Indian Wells 2026 - Day 6 Singles Round Robin
programme.desc: The WTA Finals is the pinnacle of the sport with eight singles players and doubles teams that have qualified in the Race to the Finals competing for tennis’ ultimate prize. programme.title: 河洛歌仔戏-【彼岸花】

programme.title: 情比姊妹深第4集
programme.desc: 黎兰章出生于南部农家，从小跟著父亲做农，结婚后家庭幸福美满，孰料先生早逝，她独力抚养两个孩子，这段期间兰章受到朋友同事的关心与照顾，才能度过人生的低潮，为了回馈社会的爱心，兰章加入了慈济。因受到上人的感召，兰章自认文的不会，武的也不会，只会做环保。兰章十几年不感动许多志工纷纷加入，但困难的是始终没有固定的环保点，她的坚持与不退，感动了丽梅师姊，提供固定的场地给兰章做环保，也终于不用再流浪。她们用做环保来实践上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，兰章跟丽梅认为环保道场就是人间净土，也是她们及志工们的心灵修道场。

programme.title: 行动现场第567集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.desc: 听故事，曾经是儿时最大的期待。好听的故事，更是百听不厌、刻骨铭心。 《证严上人说故事》是证严上人从多年生活历练中摘取得来的智慧结晶。在一则则风趣浅白故事中，她告诉我们，在生命的经营里，如果被『名』枷『利』锁绑住，而失去心灵空间，那将是一种无法弥补的损失。

programme.title: 风月同天第7集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法华经序系花莲静思精舍，于每日拂晓时分，僧俗二众的早课实录，意在启发自性本具的大乘精神；旨于引导大众常行菩萨道。除心无旁骛专注于当下课诵的经文外，同时扩及日常生活每一刻的专注、培养慈悲佛心，学习缩小自我，破我执，达到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 志为人医守护爱2.0第210集
programme.desc:
什么是有温度的医疗？什么是医疗之魂？医疗团队除了在诊间、在手术室、在病房抢救生命之外，还能做些什么？
『志为人医守护爱』带您目击动人的温馨医病情现场，透过医疗团队的视病如亲、 以病为师的坚持、病患与医疗团队的互相感恩，体会与感受现代人医如何帮助病患重拾信心，在他们人生低潮时重新出发，进而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 行动现场第545集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: 情比姊妹深第4集
programme.desc: 黎兰章出生于南部农家，从小跟著父亲做农，结婚后家庭幸福美满，孰料先生早逝，她独力抚养两个孩子，这段期间兰章受到朋友同事的关心与照顾，才能度过人生的低潮，为了回馈社会的爱心，兰章加入了慈济。因受到上人的感召，兰章自认文的不会，武的也不会，只会做环保。兰章十几年不感动许多志工纷纷加入，但困难的是始终没有固定的环保点，她的坚持与不退，感动了丽梅师姊，提供固定的场地给兰章做环保，也终于不用再流浪。她们用做环保来实践上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，兰章跟丽梅认为环保道场就是人间净土，也是她们及志工们的心灵修道场。

programme.desc: 黎兰章出生于南部农家，从小跟著父亲做农，结婚后家庭幸福美满，孰料先生早逝，她独力抚养两个孩子，这段期间兰章受到朋友同事的关心与照顾，才能度过人生的低潮，为了回馈社会的爱心，兰章加入了慈济。因受到上人的感召，兰章自认文的不会，武的也不会，只会做环保。兰章十几年不感动许多志工纷纷加入，但困难的是始终没有固定的环保点，她的坚持与不退，感动了丽梅师姊，提供固定的场地给兰章做环保，也终于不用再流浪。她们用做环保来实践上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，兰章跟丽梅认为环保道场就是人间净土，也是她们及志工们的心灵修道场。

programme.title: 名人书房第96集

programme.title: 证严上人说故事第285集
programme.desc: 听故事，曾经是儿时最大的期待。好听的故事，更是百听不厌、刻骨铭心。 《证严上人说故事》是证严上人从多年生活历练中摘取得来的智慧结晶。在一则则风趣浅白故事中，她告诉我们，在生命的经营里，如果被『名』枷『利』锁绑住，而失去心灵空间，那将是一种无法弥补的损失。

programme.title: 风月同天第40集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集

programme.title: 映照人生第506集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.desc: 一个一小时的节目，能带给观众什么，能影响什么？如果把它只当成一个节目，会感觉短短一小时很短暂，如果把它当成一条出路，会发现力量也可以很强大，一直以来，我们节目的理念就是寻求一种改变的可能性，只要有一个人因为看过报导而改变了，反省也好，感动也好，警惕也好，行动也好，就有可能形塑一种新的环境公民力量，也有可能让错误的政策不再继续。1998年11月1日「我们的岛」节目正式播出，当年台湾的环境还处于大肆开发的年代，在经济挂帅的氛围中，「我们的岛」为环境发出另一种声音，至今「我们的岛」仍是台湾媒体中，唯一以「环境」为报导主题的新闻性节目，也是公共电视开播以来历史最久的新闻性节目，这十五年「我们的岛」制作

programme.desc: 蜂蜜山丘居民正在准备他们最爱的小镇节，因为到时可以看到世上绝无仅有的黄金蜂巢，据说是开山鼻祖发现的，若是搞丢蜂蜜山丘将会灾厄连连，然而黄金蜂巢在小镇节前夕被人偷了，居民拜托猫头鹰侦探苏菲的松鼠助手阿奇协助破案，阿奇和他的伙伴不仅要找回黄金蜂巢，还要揪出小偷，让蜂蜜山丘居民回归平静的生活。

programme.title: 酷狗宝贝-剃刀边缘第1集
programme.desc: 这一次，华莱士和他忠心耿耿的狗狗阿高开办了清洁业务。在位羊毛店清洁时，华莱士迷上了女店主温德琳，却不知这家羊毛店正在从事不可告人的勾当。与此同时，华莱士的家来了一名不速之客——小羊肖恩。这个大胃王惹出了不少乱子，却也给华莱士和阿高带来许多乐趣。谁知好景不长，阿高竟被当作杀羊凶手而逮捕，为了救出它，华莱士和肖恩以及其他的绵羊们组织了缜密的营救行动…

programme.title: 忘川遥第1集

programme.title: 豪华露营探险之旅第5集
programme.desc: 本节目以生活旅游方式呈现，介绍「豪华露营- Glamping」这个近年流行的新型态旅游方式，透过二位主持人，带领我们走访蒙古戈壁、西藏诺顿、土耳其阿瓦隆、印尼阿曼瓦娜等多国各地，记录如何在不同地区、风景、人文和多变多样的露营需求下，整体规划的思考脉络和英变措施。

programme.title: 当昼新闻第318集
programme.desc: 《当昼新闻》是一个日间新闻节目，提供即时、全面的国内外新闻报导，涵盖政治、经济、社会、文化等多方面的重要议题。这个节目专注于在白天时段向观众传递当下最重要的新闻资讯，让观众随时掌握时事动向，并对众多议题保持关注和理解。无论是政治动荡、经济变化，或者社会事件和文化创新，这个节目都将为观众带来最及时的报导和解析。

programme.title: 《初心。登场》单歌第11集
programme.desc: 延续「客家制噪」音乐盛典品牌，2025年结合实境拍摄全新打造「初心。登场」系列节目，团队跨越近一年时间纪录八组音乐人回归创作初心，挑战前所未有的「第一次」登台。从平均年龄最年轻的乐团到摇滚天后，从独立另类到流行经典，囊括金曲得主、经典唱将、演唱团体、亮眼新秀，多样曲风加上最感动的创作初心，联手专业团队打造出耗资千万的演唱会！

programme.title: 胡来旅行社2第2集
programme.desc: 承接《胡来旅行社》第一季的热情，这次再度出发将旅行社开进花莲！持续深耕在地、服务乡亲，带著重振观光的心，走访花莲各地，除了帮旅客安排客制化的旅游行程外，更希望为震后的花莲注入活水，让大家看见花莲不一样的魅力。

programme.title: 暗夜新闻第318集

programme.desc: 夜深了，多拉A梦拿出法宝，悄悄借走5分25秒搭乘时光机回到过去。爱丽丝梦游仙境里的白兔先生，慌乱中不小心落下了5分25秒。霍格华兹里的某位学徒施了错误魔法，失手把5分25秒变不见了。哎呦哎呦!是谁偷走了爱呦阿卡贝拉的5分25秒?小女孩瞇起眼睛遥摇头，怀中的小猫叹了一口气，就连树洞里的小精灵也是无奈。不是机器猫、不是大白兔，也不是小巫师。哎呦哎呦!到底是谁偷走了爱呦阿卡贝拉的5分25秒!一切谜底将在桃园市客家文化馆演艺厅揭晓！

programme.title: 河中巨怪第3季:第5集
programme.desc: 这集的河中巨怪中，杰洛米韦德前往巴西，追查一起造成三名牛仔死亡的河怪传言，尽管杰洛米因常来巴西而对当地相当熟悉，但这次要追查的河怪却相当陌生，在查出任何线索前他已开始尝试钓鱼，先钓到黑食人鱼，接著又钓到斑点河𫚉，然而在与意外目击者交谈后，杰洛米推翻了这两种鱼造成牛仔死亡的可能性，目击者甚至猜测凶手应为电鳗。由于从未捕过电鳗，杰洛米对牠们有一定程度的疑虑，在接触过帕拉大学的鱼类专家强纳森瑞迪博士，及为另一名牛仔验尸的病理学家艾弗帕诺维奇医师后，杰洛米更确定电鳗便是他要追捕的头号嫌犯，但由于电鳗神出鬼没，他始终无法钓到电鳗进行确认，尤其对电鳗可一次电死三人，他心中仍存有怀疑，所幸在雨季降临的前一刻

programme.title: 金矿的赌注-救星佛莱迪第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 在本集中，璜与佛莱迪接受李史考特和他女儿金丝莉的委托来到蒙大拿州的赫勒拿，解决让他们相当头大的矿砂阻塞问题并调整机具配置，一圆李的淘金梦。

programme.title: 艾伦最强档新出路第1季:第19集
programme.desc: 艾伦考夫曼这次向陆海空分别进击，首先来到棕榈泉天空缆车，随著工作人员攀上缆车塔柱，更换钢缆槽轮。接著体验一种特殊交通工具，气垫船，但他发现气垫船操作起来并不轻松。最后他到德州休士顿，摆放一位特殊木工，他的专长是用木头打造汽车。

programme.title: 旧货猎人修复篇第5季
programme.desc: 德鲁普里察精挑细选古董旧货，交给工匠团队巧手修复，赋予全新生命。他们将看似无用的旧物修复成赚钱宝物，虽然客户挑三拣四，但潜在利润惊人。

programme.title: 原始生活21天第10季:第2集

programme.title: 金矿的赌注特别篇第16季:第2集

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:第12集
programme.desc: 英国摩根汽车公司出产新一代三轮车，它的车架是用木材制造的，搭配两公升引擎，各项组装都是由人工装配，并且用防水皮革打造内装。印度BS成衣公司生产用竹棉做成的衣服，这种布料抗菌、快干又除臭，会在织布机中加入弹性纤维以增加耐用度，并进行染色、剪裁、缝纫，就能制作成各式各样的衣服。土耳其的维特拉工厂每年生产超过五百万个马桶，其原料是矿物、石英、长石和瓷土，由氧化铝球研磨混合物并过滤，再将泥浆灌入模具烘烤，冷却上釉后即完成。

programme.title: 金矿的赌注急流篇第8季:第12集
programme.desc: 达斯汀如果无法在暴风雪来临前的五天内淘到够大够多的金块，只能卖掉采矿用地以停损。

programme.title: 金帝手工车厂第9季:第2集
programme.desc: 金帝车厂首度改装的第三代新星完工。这应该是目前全球第一辆硬顶第三代新星肌肉车。

programme.title: 网路诈骗第1季:第3集

programme.title: 旧货猎人修复篇第5季
programme.desc: 德鲁普里察精挑细选古董旧货，交给工匠团队巧手修复，赋予全新生命。他们将看似无用的旧物修复成赚钱宝物，虽然客户挑三拣四，但潜在利润惊人。

programme.title: 河中巨怪第3季:第3集
programme.desc: 这集的河中巨怪中，杰洛米韦德前往日本，调查日本民间的一些恐怖传说，此趟日本行让他觉得异常辛苦，因为日本民间有许多这类传说，尤其每个人的说法都不尽相同，因此让他难以判断，然而抽丝剥茧后，他锁定两个方向追查两种河中巨怪，一是会引发地震的地震鲶，另一个则是会掳走并杀害孩童的河怪河童，地震鲶的传说是说地底有只巨鲶，一移动身躯便会引发地震，由于常理判断鲶鱼不可能真的长得如此巨大，因此杰洛米认为是鲶鱼的行为模式会于地震发生前出现变化，请教矢田教授后确定了鲶鱼的这种特性，等于验证了地震鲶的传说；接著杰洛米开始追查河童，日本民间对河童的传说，让此河怪看来像是结合了多种动物，然而追查过程中，杰洛米却判断某些细节

programme.title: 河中巨怪第3季:第4集
programme.desc: 杰洛米韦德20年前左右第一次去亚马逊河钓鱼时，在一家五金店偶然发现外型像电锯的东西，那就是锯鳐的鼻锯。他虽然耳闻锯鳐攻击人类的故事，却不曾亲眼见过这种巨怪。他心里有两大疑问，这种海生掠食者为什么会游到淡水？锯鳐真如其外表般致命吗？为了寻找这种几乎从地表消失的巨怪，杰洛米来到澳洲西北荒凉地区。当地见过锯鳐的钓客把锯鳐形容得很可怕，不慎的话甚至有送命的危险。河里甚至还有虎视眈眈的鳄鱼，在这种环境钓鱼可以说是难上加难。杰洛米钓了几天都没有斩获，于是向当地原住民请益，学习他们抛网捕鱼的方法。最后杰洛米和一个锯鳐研究小组碰头，希望能再试试运气，无奈天气开始转坏，又得转移阵地，究竟杰洛米能不能钓到传说中的

programme.title: 渔人的搏斗第22季:第12集

programme.title: 远古未解之谜第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 古代世界耐人寻味，无论是史前时期或是文字出现后的时代皆有许多未解的谜题。本集节目讨论了几个神秘案例，包括智利一处只有残破头骨的墓地，新墨西哥白沙国家公园里会突然出现又消失的巨大脚印，英格兰乡间山坡上的巨大白垩画像，以及维苏威火山爆发罹难者尸骸上发现的神秘物质。想知道这些案例背后的真相，敬请锁定本节目。

programme.title: 全美梦幻婚纱第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 密西根州的代表新娘蕾西本来以为要来帮新娘客户做发妆，没想到走进屋却看到蓝迪。蕾西希望找到有密西根春天花朵盛开意象的婚纱。新娘凯蒂带著妈妈、阿姨与姑姑一起来挑婚纱，她们之前已经在另一间婚纱店相中一件，但凯蒂觉得好像没有感受到「新娘的感动」，因此想来克莱菲尔婚纱店确认一下。

programme.title: 狗狗101第3季:第2集
programme.desc: 巴生吉犬来自于历史悠久的古埃及，嗅觉与视觉皆相当良好，独立温和，由于不爱吠叫因此适合养在都市中。斗牛獒犬显示出极大的力量、耐性和机敏，也具有沉稳、忠实、富有感情的性格。现在多使用于军警界。喜乐蒂牧羊犬犬多数是明朗活泼，但与工作犬比较之下，个性较纤细、神经质。要每天梳整及注意运动，即可成为绝佳的家犬。美国爱斯基摩犬是严寒地带既积极又勤力的工作犬，结构紧凑且非常匀称，体质良好。棉花面纱犬起源于17世纪。认为是法国军团将含有比熊血统的品种带到马达加斯加岛，现在该岛已经成为该品种的培育地，这种高贵、温顺、机灵的犬种在美国越来越受到欢迎。大庇里牛斯犬具有很强的忍耐力与很高的警觉性。拥有威严身驱、温柔的脸

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第19集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些狠角色却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是莫三比克中部的魔花螳螂。光是看到这种名称，就能想见这种螳螂肯定非常威猛，而牠也确实名不虚传，除了可以跳出将近十倍身长的距离，还能举起比自己体重多五倍的猎物，一把将猎物抓起后就直接吞下肚子，猎物甚至还没死亡呢。

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第20集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些小怪物却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是寮国的鳄鱼蝾螈，这种蝾螈就像全身都覆盖了毒素地雷，神奇的毒囊一受到刺激就会喷出毒素；更厉害的是，只要牠的头部和脊椎保持完整，就算手脚断掉都能再重新长回来，几乎可以达到永生不死的境界。

programme.title: 狗狗101第3季:第3集
programme.desc: 澳洲牧牛犬被培育来协助农夫放牧牛羊，目前这个忠实的犬种在牧场上依旧受欢迎，但或许会想赶幼童，因此不适合有幼童的家庭。沙路奇猎犬是以速度闻名的异国视觉型猎犬，牠来自中东，在穆斯林世界备受尊崇。诺威奇梗犬是聪明的犬种，在电视广告与电影界深受欢迎，也受到名流仕绅的喜爱。帕金猎犬是一流的猎犬，由南卡罗莱纳州的户外猎人培育，牠们在该州深受喜爱，是南卡罗莱纳的州狗，在猎鸭季节经常看见牠们的踪影，也被印制在邮票上。斗牛梗的外表强悍，幸好不擅长打斗，而是成功的宠物，史巴兹麦肯西协助卖百威淡啤酒，鲁法斯则是史上最战功彪炳的展场狗。喀地干威尔斯柯基犬是独特的小狗，被培育来放牧大型动物，目前牠们主要是玩赏犬，适合与

programme.title: 警犬出动第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 英国的领犬员和他们的警犬搭档有时出生入死，在工作中也经常遭遇许多困难。员警大卫麦肯泰尔的警犬搭档鲁迪是一只德国狼犬，参与攻坚行动行动时会大声吠叫，恫吓坏人，但大卫在几次训练中发现牠的表现有些异状。因为担心牠的身体不适，所以大卫决定带牠去兽医院检查，赫然发现牠的前列腺有肿胀，必须进一步检查是否罹患癌症；在等待检查结果的一周时间，对大卫是无法承受的煎熬，尽管后来得知是囊肿发炎破裂，但医生认为鲁迪必须开刀切除囊肿，这对于鲁迪的警犬生涯更添一大变数。

programme.title: 百变水族箱第8季:第14集
programme.desc: 野火肆虐加州索诺马郡，火灾波及森林、农场、住家，造成人、畜伤亡和流离失所。科丁镇购物中心想打造一个大水族箱，将被野火焚毁的社区地标—红谷仓永远保留在水族箱里，同时放入受野火摧毁严重的当地物种—赤杉，以及逃过焚毁命运的LOVE雕塑。以这个水族箱纪念购物中心的创始人，同时向火灾发生时，英勇的的紧急应变人员与消防员致敬。

programme.title: 走出首尔-南韩的自然奇观第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 南韩偏远岛屿与湿地孕育独特自然与人文风景，居民靠农渔维生、传承技艺。

programme.title: 最萌宠物秀
programme.desc: 节目介绍许多可爱又特别的宠物，牠们带给人们无限的欢乐，也让人们感受到牠们旺盛的生命斗志。例如两只原本无家可归的吉娃娃犬坎卡和鲁，天生就没有前腿，但牠们没有怀忧丧志，总是跳来跳去穿上衣服展现萌样，甚至为流浪犬认养的服装比赛活动担任评审。还有纽约州长岛的流浪犬探戈，成为第一只进入港边跳远冠军赛的斗牛犬，打败了许多纯种拉布拉多猎犬和觅拾犬，也破除许多人对斗牛犬的成见。

programme.title: 热血兽医师第3季:第9集
programme.desc: 杰夫医生带著兽医团队重返墨西哥，这是他每年都会安排的旅程，为墨西哥的偏乡地区从事免费兽医服务，而且这次他的团队甚至前往从未踏足过的地区。因为墨西哥的贫苦人家连自己都可能养不起，更遑论将猫狗宠物送去做绝育手术。但猫狗的繁殖力非常强，当饲主养不起而弃养时，就会造成严重的流浪猫狗问题。杰夫医生的策略就是带领一群当地医生，在短时间内完成大量的猫狗20个绝育手术，这样才能有效地降低对当地的流浪猫狗数量。一群认同杰夫医生的墨西哥兽医，长期加入这个活动，共同为墨西哥的偏乡兽医服务尽一份力。

programme.title: 野地暖春第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 该系列节目探讨了新生命的诞生，以及随之而来的丰富多样的育儿方式，因为新生命的到来也带来了机会。

programme.title: 野地求生奇才第1季:第2集

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第15集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些小动物却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是泰国竹林里的独角仙。以昆虫的标准来说，独角仙的体型已经非常可观，这种昆虫界的摔角选手拥有天生神力，不仅可以用两支大角夹住与之竞争的同类对手，甚至还能推动比自己体重还多五百倍的木材，大力士的称号非牠莫属。

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第16集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些狠角色却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是泰国的亚洲臭鼩。牠的外观看起来就像老鼠，走起路来也像老鼠，但牠却是罕见的有毒哺乳类，牠的毒液可以让猎物麻痺瘫痪，一被牠抓到就没有逃命的机会；此外，牠急速转弯的速度和角度，就连羚羊都望尘莫及，简直就是棕榈树林中的弯道女王。

programme.title: 灭绝动物大追踪第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，野生生物学家佛瑞斯特葛兰特，将前往佛罗里达的艾弗格雷兹沼泽，寻找神秘的黑色大型掠食动物。当地的目击者说牠是黑豹，但北美黑豹的存在从来没经过证实，另一种可能是佛罗里达黑狼，但这种生物早已被宣告灭绝。佛瑞斯特能解开谜团，揭露神秘黑色动物的真面目吗？

programme.title: 深海怪鲨之最
programme.desc: 本集节目集结了《深海怪鲨》五年来的精华，揭露鲨鱼界最奇怪的适应法、突变、怪眼、颚部等。介绍了分布于世界各地的剑吻鲨、皱腮鲨、铠鲨、双髻鲨、象鲨等十多种鲨鱼，赞叹大自然的奇妙之余，也宣扬环保及动保意识。

programme.title: 老虎血脉第1季:第2集

programme.title: 警犬出动第1季:第6集

programme.title: 警犬出动第1季:第7集

programme.desc: 甲壳类是数量庞大的一群生物，至少有5万个物种，属于节肢动物门。

programme.desc: 全球水鸟大致可以分成真水鸟，涉禽及海鸟三类，牠们面临许多困境，污染，土地开垦以及地球暖化，都危及水鸟的生存。

programme.title: 超级蝙蝠车第47集
programme.desc: 蝙蝠侠、罗宾以及蝙蝠女孩因一起阴谋而离开蝙蝠洞，蝙蝠电脑于是将她的主机板复制到蝙蝠车上，赋予它们「生命」。刚诞生的「超级蝙蝠车」随即展开保卫已曝光的蝙蝠洞，及对抗邪恶敌人「 the Legion of Zoom!」的重大任务。跟著令人惊叹的超级车队一同前行，看剧中帅气的班姆、小碧、红鸟、巴夫，和蝙蝠飞翼是如何帮助蝙蝠侠、蝙蝠女孩和罗宾，一同守护高谭市的安全。纵使面对「Legion of Zoom」，或是其他高谭市恶名昭彰的超级反派，超级蝙蝠车都将使用他们令人难以置信的小装置和创意的团队合作来拯救这一天。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第121集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 摇滚吧！宝贝第305集
programme.desc: 音乐是一种世界语言，当你在一个语言不通的地方，拿起乐器来哼唱几句，就能快速连结彼此的心。对于正处于语言能力疾速发展的儿童，接触音乐更能和 语言学习相辅相成。已有多项研究证明，让发育中的幼儿接触乐器，可以刺激脑部神经，增进创造力，加强耐心及专注力。

programme.title: 金厉害潜水艇第138集
programme.desc: 年轻天真的海豚金厉害带领一艘装满鱼儿和海水的另类潜水艇，打算前往他们梦寐以求，具有纯净水源的陆地~拉斯维加斯。但这段奇葩的海陆大冒险沿途总是波折不断，有时内忧有时外患，一点也不平静…

programme.title: 少年悍将 Go第1114集
programme.desc: 《少年悍将！GO》是2013年卡通频道和华纳制作的卡通电视节目。也是DC系列《少年悍将》漫画的改编卡通，跟前作不同点在于，本作画法以萌系画风呈现，更大的特点是它著重在喜剧效果上，没有前作的黑暗、严肃气氛，剧中多围绕在少年悍将们的平时生活。本做最大的看点是制作组将许多DC的人物做为背景角色呈现。

programme.title: 宝贝乐一通第13集
programme.desc: 在成为叛逆无礼的经典乐一通动画短片前，兔宝宝、太菲鸭和死党们都还是刚学走路的小小孩，天真无邪的好奇宝宝。 特别为学龄前儿童设计的宝贝乐一通将为卡通迷们隆重介绍这些可爱讨喜的小小明星；节目将以较小体型、甜蜜讨喜的方式呈现无比欢乐的经典卡通明星。兔宝宝、太菲鸭、傻大鸟、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充满冒险行动的维多利亚式宅第中，可是一群鬼灵精怪的小捣蛋鬼。 小兔宝宝和朋友们将邀请所有小小卡通迷，探索这个无奇不有的欢乐世界。

programme.title: 超级蝙蝠车第45集
programme.desc: 蝙蝠侠、罗宾以及蝙蝠女孩因一起阴谋而离开蝙蝠洞，蝙蝠电脑于是将她的主机板复制到蝙蝠车上，赋予它们「生命」。刚诞生的「超级蝙蝠车」随即展开保卫已曝光的蝙蝠洞，及对抗邪恶敌人「 the Legion of Zoom!」的重大任务。跟著令人惊叹的超级车队一同前行，看剧中帅气的班姆、小碧、红鸟、巴夫，和蝙蝠飞翼是如何帮助蝙蝠侠、蝙蝠女孩和罗宾，一同守护高谭市的安全。纵使面对「Legion of Zoom」，或是其他高谭市恶名昭彰的超级反派，超级蝙蝠车都将使用他们令人难以置信的小装置和创意的团队合作来拯救这一天。

programme.title: 少年悍将 Go第181集
programme.desc: 《少年悍将！GO》是2013年卡通频道和华纳制作的卡通电视节目。也是DC系列《少年悍将》漫画的改编卡通，跟前作不同点在于，本作画法以萌系画风呈现，更大的特点是它著重在喜剧效果上，没有前作的黑暗、严肃气氛，剧中多围绕在少年悍将们的平时生活。本做最大的看点是制作组将许多DC的人物做为背景角色呈现。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第123集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 摇滚吧！宝贝第307集
programme.desc: 音乐是一种世界语言，当你在一个语言不通的地方，拿起乐器来哼唱几句，就能快速连结彼此的心。对于正处于语言能力疾速发展的儿童，接触音乐更能和 语言学习相辅相成。已有多项研究证明，让发育中的幼儿接触乐器，可以刺激脑部神经，增进创造力，加强耐心及专注力。

programme.title: 金厉害潜水艇第131集
programme.desc: 年轻天真的海豚金厉害带领一艘装满鱼儿和海水的另类潜水艇，打算前往他们梦寐以求，具有纯净水源的陆地~拉斯维加斯。但这段奇葩的海陆大冒险沿途总是波折不断，有时内忧有时外患，一点也不平静…

programme.title: 动物大联盟第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 透过纪实的镜头画面一起认识动物的习性和生态，生动地介绍动物知识，展示动物世界的多姿多彩。感受动物大联盟的能量，看动物们各个深藏不露的好本领，尊重珍惜大自然，动物生态才得以永续生生不息。

programme.title: MOMO欢乐谷第12季:第6集
programme.desc: 最适合小朋友观赏的优质儿童律动节目。除了好听的歌曲及好看的唱跳表演，还有哥哥和姐姐们的游戏大PK。另透过说故事的启发引导儿童们，为儿童们解答生活上和人际关系上的众多疑惑。

programme.title: 露营小玩家第13集
programme.desc: 全台唯一露营亲子节目 哥哥姐姐要带著大家走进大自然， 在美丽的山谷里露营， 在青翠的草原上玩乐， 露营小玩家，放假换个家。

programme.title: MO蜜点亮好朋友第20集
programme.desc: 想跟「MO蜜点亮」一起去闯关吗？节目中有四个关卡，会提出不同的问题，只要选出正确答案，就可以获得一个章，集满四个章即闯关成功啰！节目内容皆由生活出发，生活中小朋友会遇到的状况，友情小故事、逻辑推理、常用的生活英文以及可爱的舞蹈，在节目中展现出来；并设计成闯关题目，将要传达的理念结合其中，让小朋友以主观视角进行答题选择，在无压力的状态下学习成长。「MO蜜点亮好朋友」，由MOMO台的大明星-MOMO、小蜜、点点、亮亮，由孩子的视角及对话，让MO蜜点亮以好朋友的角色，陪伴小朋友们度过快乐的童年时光。

programme.title: ㄅㄨㄌㄨㄅㄨㄌㄨ，快乐学游泳第7集
programme.desc: 《ㄅㄨㄌㄨㄅㄨㄌㄨ，快乐学游泳》是一档学龄前儿童游泳节目，带著观众前的小朋友跟著主角小宁，一起展开一场快乐学游泳之旅！

programme.title: 碰碰红绿豆第1007集
programme.desc: 红豆妮与绿豆兵，是一对来自TOP星球的外星姊弟。在地球被天才发明家WHY博士收养，与拥有超能力的豆子朋友们展开充满趣味的每一天！

programme.title: 泡泡孔雀鱼第50集
programme.desc: 这是一个集音乐、舞蹈、娱乐为一体的儿童动画。讲述的是一群学龄前儿童在水下城市Bubbletucky中的各种经历。透过广泛的节目主题设定，以及多元具活力及启发性的水族教室，让学龄前小朋友们和节目里茉莉、吉儿和她们的鱼同学们，在音乐和欢笑里学习科学、数学、文学，一起探索及认识世界。

programme.title: 神木岛第2集
programme.desc: 爱吹牛的小学生小安，意外坠入异世界—神木岛。这个美丽的世界正因生态变异而面临危机，为了找到回家的路，他必须与当地的伙伴们组队，踏上寻找传说中「神木之心」的远征，在这段旅程中，他必须学会诚实、勇敢与合作，才能真正成长，并拯救这个接纳他的新家园。

programme.title: 昆虫岛第10集
programme.desc: 在某个昆虫岛上住了许多的昆虫，萤火虫亚当来到了昆虫岛，他发现自己和大家不同， 对身体会发光感到自卑，容易害羞又紧张的亚当，能和大家成为好朋友吗？

programme.title: 喵喵魔法盒第8集
programme.desc: Kit和Kate是一对兄妹，他们的家中有一个神奇魔法盒，放满心爱的玩具和宝物。两兄妹最爱跳进神奇的魔法盒，出发去探险，每次遇到不同挑战，两只活泼又顽皮的小猫咪懂得作出最正确的选择吗？

programme.title: DORA第10集
programme.desc: 朵拉（Dora）和她的猴子朋友Boots在雨林中展开的史诗级冒险。朵拉（Dora）和她的朋友们必须齐心协力，克服雨林中的重重障碍。

programme.title: Hello Kitty-Super Style！第10集
programme.desc: 在这部充满乐趣与动感的剧集中，Hello Kitty 是樱桃镇的友善英雄，总是竭尽全力帮助朋友，带来微笑与勇气。无论是克服恐惧、学会分享，还是尝试新事物，她都用善良和爱心展现超凡的力量。当朋友需要帮助时，她将成为探险家、侦探、厨师、歌星等角色，用智慧与勇气解决问题。Hello Kitty 的超级友谊精神团结了樱桃镇，让小镇更加温暖有爱！

programme.title: 袋鼠海滩救援队第28集
programme.desc: 在资深救生员的带领下接受训练，学习成为守护海滩的救生小队。当海滩出现突发状况时，他们总是第一时间出动，从帮助迷路的小海龟找到回家的方向，到协助被海浪冲离岸边的小朋友安全返回岸上，每一次任务都充满紧张刺激的海滩冒险，也展现出勇气、智慧与团队合作的力量。跟著 小庞、莉兹、洁玛、奈奈 一起展开充满欢笑的友谊大冒险！

programme.title: 汪汪队立大功-汪汪喵喵救援队第2集

programme.desc: 大雄和他的朋友们受不了酷夏的炎热，于是决定前往巨大冰山玩耍。他们使用道具「冰雕工艺组」做出了一个游乐园，无意间发现了一个被结冻的手环。哆啦A梦用道具调查之后发现，这个手环居然是在不应该有人类存在的10万年前的南极被冰封起来的。他们跑到南极调查手环的主人，竟然在冰层下发现一座巨大的城市遗迹。「我们前往10万年前，把失物还给主人吧！」 哆啦A梦一行人使用「时光腰带」前往10万年前，遇到了少女卡菈与希亚克伊博士，他们为了拯救自己被冰封的星球，进行太空旅行前来追寻手环之谜。随著手环的真相逐渐明朗，哆啦A梦他们也将面临地球冻结的危机！

programme.title: 名侦探光之美少女第33集
programme.desc: 明智安娜是住在真心未来镇的14岁国中二年级生！在生日那天出现的精灵包包，以及房间里的项链引导下，她从2027年穿越时空来到1999年的真心未来市，她在那里遇见了向往成为名侦探的14岁少女小林未来！ 就在这时，事件发生了！？似乎有人因为重要的东西被偷走而伤透脑筋… 犯案的是幻影怪盗团 ！ 无法对需要帮助的人视而不见……！安娜与未来抱著这样的想法，变身成【名侦探光之美少女】。 名侦探光之美少女将用推理守护大家的笑容。「这个谜团，就靠天使破案！」而安娜是否能回到原本的时代呢……！？

programme.title: 蜡笔小新-爆盛！功夫小子~拉面大乱斗~第1集
programme.desc: 拉面危机，看小新变成功夫boy。故事发生在春日部的中华街上的《哎呀城》，「正男」邀请「小新」与「春日部防卫队」，学习传说中的功夫－软Q软Q拳。并和功夫少女「小兰」一起努力练功。这时候，神秘面食”黑熊猫拉面”大流行。那是只要吃过一次就会上瘾，且让人变得凶暴的恐怖拉面！面对这突如袭来的拉面危机！为了拯救哎呀城，春日部防卫队挺身而出，他们能够恢复街上的和平吗？

programme.title: 马达加斯加-电影版3-欧洲大围捕第1集
programme.desc: 爱力狮、马蹄、河马莉和长颈男这群动物园伙伴再度踏上遥遥无期的返家之路，他们一直想要回到他们所爱的纽约家园：纽约市的中央公园动物园。牠们离开非洲，到欧洲蒙地卡罗赌场找会开飞机的企鹅帮，不料被法国动物管制局女队长杜波娃盯上，一路追捕牠们。牠们逃命时混进一个巡回马戏团，发现马戏团可能到纽约演出，瞎掰自己会马戏特技，希望借机返家。

programme.title: 名侦探光之美少女第34集
programme.desc: 明智安娜是住在真心未来镇的14岁国中二年级生！在生日那天出现的精灵包包，以及房间里的项链引导下，她从2027年穿越时空来到1999年的真心未来市，她在那里遇见了向往成为名侦探的14岁少女小林未来！ 就在这时，事件发生了！？似乎有人因为重要的东西被偷走而伤透脑筋… 犯案的是幻影怪盗团 ！ 无法对需要帮助的人视而不见……！安娜与未来抱著这样的想法，变身成【名侦探光之美少女】。 名侦探光之美少女将用推理守护大家的笑容。「这个谜团，就靠天使破案！」而安娜是否能回到原本的时代呢……！？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主第53集
programme.desc: 主角青空阳葵和星川美月，一起进入私立乐园学园就读。对偶像公主怀抱著憧憬的阳葵，梦想是交一万个朋友！但这对怕生又容易紧张的阳葵来说，可能有点困难……没想到这样的阳葵，居然要以偶像公主的身分出道了？！她不小心有了连对好友美月都不能说的「秘密」！然而，美月似乎也怀抱著某个「秘密」……身怀秘密的阳葵和美月，两位偶像公主的故事，就此揭开序幕！！

programme.title: 大英雄天团第1集
programme.desc: 故事发生在一个虚构的未来混合大都市「旧京山」，14岁发明天才少年滨田广的最新发明「微型机器人」，竟然令他卷入足以摧毁旧京山的巨大阴谋！孤立无援，阿广只能借助一班另类势力，由宅宅实验室里四个哥哥的朋友包括芥末无姜、化学天才哈妮蕾梦、单车信差神行蛋葆、宅男漫画迷费吉拉及医护机器人杯面。阿广为朋友和自己配上了高科技超级装备，6人组成了能力非凡的「大英雄天团」。

programme.title: 蜡笔小新-不理不理王国的秘宝第1集
programme.desc: 小新和妈妈上街买菜意外抽中了头奖，获得免费招待全家前往遥远的不理不理王国，没想到一家人高兴地上了飞机后，却出现神秘组织白蛇帮派出的人妖意图绑架小新，小新和爸妈急忙跳伞降落在丛林中，在猴子帮助才逃过一劫，并在火车上认识了皇室亲卫官美女露露，这才得知长相酷似小新的王子也遭白蛇帮绑架，这时白蛇帮的人追来抢走了小新，原来白蛇帮的老大阿那康达和手下哈布，为了夺取不理不理王国传说中的宝藏，必须靠王子和小新才能打开宫殿之门，而那个宝藏竟是瓶中拥有无穷法力的大魔神，小新能阻止他们的阴谋吗…

programme.title: 神偷奶爸第1集
programme.desc: 《神偷奶爸》，2010年喜剧3D动画片，是神偷奶爸系列电影的首部作品，由环球影业及照明娱乐制作，首部两家合作的电脑动画电影。讲述神偷格鲁项目利用三个孤儿女作为他伟大偷月项目的棋子，直到发现她们天真的爱深刻地改变他。该片由《冰川时代》、《霍顿与无名氏》监制克里斯梅勒丹德利制作；导演是曾入围奥斯卡动画短片奖《松鼠、坚果和时间机器》的克里斯雷纳德，以及皮尔考芬共同执导。

programme.title: 神偷奶爸小小兵第1集
programme.desc: 《神偷奶爸》：做坏事做上瘾的世界级大坏蛋格鲁，坐拥各种最先进的科技产品，一发起狠来，更会使用缩小光、冷冻光和陆空战车，来消灭阻止他偷月亮计划的人。有天突然来了三个活泼可爱的孤儿，搞得他手足无措，眼看他策画已久的偷月计划即将展开，他们会擦出什么样的火花？计划能成功吗？还是格鲁会变成超级奶爸呢？《小小兵》：盘古开天时期是一个黄色的有机体，随著时间演化成小小兵团，他们的存在目的就是要服侍当代最凶恶的主人，然而从恐龙、埃及法老王、拿破仑甚至是德古拉，小小兵总是不停的失败，最后发现已经没有可以服侍的主人，从此开始郁郁寡欢，逐渐凋零。其中的一只小小兵—凯文有个伟大的计划，就是带著麻吉—大胃王史都华还有胆小

programme.title: 三分野第9集

programme.title: 美乐加油第18集
programme.desc: (2011)风靡全亚洲的音乐才子韩以烈(贺军翔饰演)是某卫视知名综艺节目的评委，他性格怪异，作风霸道，经常让暗恋他的经纪人楚少茵(柳岩饰演)为其收拾烂摊子。查美乐(王心凌饰演)是一个坚强善良的平凡女孩，她相信只要努力付出就有回报。为实现男友韩以风的梦想，她放弃自己的事业开了一家面包店。美乐阴差阳错之下与冷酷霸道的未来小叔以烈相遇，美乐的热情真诚如阳光般照进了以烈冷漠的内心。某著名餐饮连锁店创办人何言劭(张伦硕饰演)打算收购美乐的面包店，以风与美乐之间的感情出现危机，以烈陪美乐度过了人生最灰暗的时刻。少茵百般阻扰以烈与美乐的交往。言劭对美乐由欣赏到日渐动情。面对以风的回心转意、言劭的强烈追求和少

programme.desc: 《世界第一等》是台湾八大电视“大视界系列”的一个旅游节目，开播于2005年，该节目风格为探险走向，大部分节目会拜访当地台商及移民，了解当地台商的成功经验及与当地华侨一同探索该国家的文化和传统。《世界第一等》探访世界各地稀奇古怪、骇人听闻的风土民情，首集即报导越南畸形村，创下1点多高收视率，在市场上引起不小震撼。虽然这节目满足观众喜欢“窥视”新奇事务的心理状态，但也借此进行人道关怀。例如首集播出畸形村后，替中华民国红十字会募得新台币一百多万元，制作单位之后也随同中华民国红十字会秘书长郝龙斌至越南捐赠该款项。

programme.title: 自由的旅行者第3季:第6集
programme.desc: 旅行本身就是一种充满自由的生活方式，带著台湾人勇往直前的精神，透过每一次旅行，站在不同角色的视点；体验不同的文化与生活；拥抱未知的人事物，让台湾与世界来一场国际级的交流，这就是每次旅程中最无可取代的收获。旅行可以是背包客独旅的ME TIME，也可以是踏出舒适圈，探索世界的壮游；更可以是人生观的改变与自我的拓展。只要带著无拘无束的心出发，你就会是个「自由的旅行者」。

programme.title: 雨夜花第11集
programme.desc: 《雨夜花》是台湾日治时期的台语流行歌曲兼民谣，由周添旺作词、邓雨贤作曲。日本人柏野正次郎所经营的古伦美亚唱片公司将其灌录成78转的唱片，由旗下歌星纯纯主唱，于1934年推出。

programme.title: 金家好媳妇第133集
programme.desc: 剧情主轴描述人与人之间永远难以割舍的亲情与爱情;而婆媳之间那本「家家都有难念的经」是每个家庭必须要面对的课题，而在「金家」的屋簷下，除了有不同世代各式各样的婆媳问题外，还有，金家年轻人们多姿多采的爱情和人生。

programme.title: 来去Check in第1季:第1集

programme.title: 来自星星的事第37集
programme.desc: 《来自星星的事》是一部韩国浪漫奇幻剧，以异星人和地球女子之间的爱情故事为核心。剧情讲述了从400年前来自外星球的千年男子都敏俊（Do Min-joon）在地球上与现代女子千颂伊（Cheon Song-yi）相遇的故事。都敏俊拥有特殊的能力，包括超凡的力量、不老不死和超感官知觉，但他选择远离人类并过著孤独的生活。然而，当他遇到千颂伊时，他的生活开始发生改变，他们之间产生了一段跨越时空的爱情。剧中探讨了爱情、牺牲、命运和人性的主题，同时也带有一些喜剧和悬疑的元素。这部剧因其精湛的演技、浪漫的剧情和视觉效果受到观众的喜爱，成为一部受欢迎的韩剧作品。

programme.desc: 管文，身为欧洲轻奢品牌缇柏逊的业务拓展部副总监，虽是公司内年资最浅的副总监，却因做事果断狠辣被誉为「千刀斩女魔头」，是公司里传言最有希望晋升下一任总监的候选人，而这最后一步的关键即是能否拿下恒天——一家齐聚了所有顶级奢侈品牌的国内排名第一商场。但在品牌拓展团队中还有位善于投机取巧的副总监莉迪娅处处与管文针锋相对，同样觊觎品牌拓展总监之位。为了获得与恒天高层林岳的见面机会，管文便联合闺蜜陈萱萱和景知秋，上演了一出「好戏」：身著优雅贴身小礼裙的管文先是在洗手间外制造了一场与恒天招商总林岳相遇的「意外」，岂料管文的巧计被林岳的一个电话打断，她回想起总监马特的忠告和莉迪娅的挑衅，便又借景知秋装醉巧取他

programme.title: 台湾百味第529集
programme.desc: 在人群攘往熙来的繁华街道里，有个老味道静静记录著时间流逝。那或许是来自家乡的味道，也或许是和家人共处的幸福味道，当然也有可能是乘载梦想的味道。《台湾百味》将带您探索这些存在于台湾各处的味道，不仅让您用美味一餐满足饥肠辘辘，也用快乐的养分滋养心生命。

programme.title: 台湾百庙第303集
programme.desc: 每一座老庙，都拥有在地发展最初始的记忆；每一炷香火，都满载乡亲里民最虔诚的心意。百年来香火不断，世代间信仰不歇，寒来暑往，流转著许多动人的故事与传奇。《台湾百庙》带您悠游台湾各处宫庙，发现最在地的民间故事，品尝最道地的庶民小吃，体验最特别的民俗风情，探索最深植人心的宫庙文化。给您最不同以往的行脚文化之旅。

programme.title: 轻松养生活第49集
programme.desc: 《轻松养生活》是一档探索健康与生活智慧的节目，分享简单易行的养生技巧、美食秘方，以及心灵成长的实用建议，旨在帮助观众建立轻松愉快的生活方式，提升生活质量。

programme.title: 反恐任务
programme.desc: 韩国国家安全局TF-A队是一支菁英情报队伍，队长郑有健能力极强，但似乎暗藏著什么秘密；队员池秀妍拥有超强的射击能力，是位不可或缺的女队员；而副局长崔敏则是出身美国五角大厦，是菁英团队的绝对核心。为了解决围绕在「白山」背后的谜团，并阻止世界恐怖组织IRIS的阴谋，他们必须赌上性命背水一战。

programme.title: 决战38度线
programme.desc: 韩战期间，美国非裔战斗机飞行员杰西奉命加入突击战斗机中队，认识了白人飞官托马斯。两人突破美国50年代的种族藩篱，成为合作无间的战友、一起执行超过20次战斗任务。一次行动中，杰西驾驶的僚机被击落，一场惊险的救援行动即将展开。

programme.title: 非诚勿扰
programme.desc: 留学海外的秦奋回到北京探望母亲，40多岁还未婚的他兴起了结婚的念头，洋洋洒洒千字的征婚启事吸引不少「特殊」女性前来赴约，甚至连男同志都来了。就在秦奋心灰意冷之际，美丽的空服员梁笑笑找上了他，但这名近乎完美的对象心里似乎藏著不少秘密。

programme.title: AI拼才会赢
programme.desc: 手艺一流却懒散的王东南，在美食评论家与好友的鼓励下，餐馆事业逐渐起飞；然而事业得意、婚姻却亮红灯。为了挽回家庭，他购入最新AI机器人「玲玲」帮忙家务，没想到却掀起一连串超展开的爆笑风波！

programme.title: 404宿灵速速逃
programme.desc: 房地产骗子那罗计划将一间废弃酒店翻修，趁机大捞一笔，想不到，酒店早已被前屋主拉莉妲的鬼魂占据，任何胆敢觊觎这里的人，都会引来怨气四溢的恐怖报复！不甘心的那罗只好找来各路萨满和巫师，准备驱除这个「千年房东」。

programme.title: 拼命三郎
programme.desc: 不再风光的江湖老大石三郎，替多年没见的儿子石头解决纷争，儿子重新认识父亲，并受到启发而专注泰拳，两代拼命逆流打拼，三郎的事业重上轨道之际，却因与昔日兄弟恩怨而让儿子受害，儿子泰拳前途被彻底摧毁，三郎为了儿子的明天，作出最拼命的反击！

programme.title: 树海村
programme.desc: 本片以日本知名的自杀景点．富士树海为舞台，叙述据说绝不能在网路上搜寻的「取子箱」，以及因树海的负能量而产生的疯狂、混沌现象的故事。从前曾令人们战栗不已、自古流传下来的强力诅咒，被封印在富士树海的深处。13年后，树海竟开始出现多起失踪案件……​

programme.title: 激斗-首部曲
programme.desc: 因反击校园霸凌误伤对方而被判入少年监狱服刑的车宇率，在狱中认识了综合格斗冠军郑道铉，不想再被欺负的车宇率决定突破自我极限，向郑道铉学习格斗技巧…

programme.title: 我的婆婆怎么把OO搞丢了
programme.desc: 苏家婆婆彩香不小心搞丢神秘「OO」引来警察的关切，苏家子女们纷纷傻眼，儿子秉仁不负责落跑、女儿秉爱挥刀逼问、秉忠不孝提议报警，最后竟连小鸥、大美都一起上铐送警局！苏家婆婆究竟捅出什么娄子？这家人又会搞出什么名堂？

programme.title: 叱咤风云
programme.desc: 曾经风光无限的LIONS车队在队长老申去世后逐渐衰退。拒绝退隐的车王李一飞面对新搭档联盟──历史上首位女车手──莉莉，两人各不相让，为车队带来了危机…

programme.title: 航海王电影-GOLD
programme.desc: 在伟大航路上闪耀著黄金般的璀璨光芒，有著世界最大的娱乐城市之称的「Grantesoro」，拥有者是吃了黄金果实的基尔德泰佐罗，有著与世界政府抗衡的财力与权力。误闯连世界政府都无法轻易干预的绝对圣域，草帽海贼团在世上最大的娱乐都市里，在一片欢乐的氛围中，发现了黄金大帝不为人知的可怕计划…。

programme.title: 音爆浩劫
programme.desc: 水煮沸的声音、打开窗户的声音、孩子们的笑声……不久后，传来了一户民宅爆炸的新闻快报，此时，看到新闻的前海军副舰长（金来沅 饰）接到了一通电话，炸弹设计者（李钟硕 饰）表示只要噪音一变大就会爆炸，他的下个目标是足球场……为了阻止不断在市中心展开的炸弹恐攻事件，一定要找出握有一切秘密的炸弹设计者！

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第197集
programme.desc: 跨世代的伙伴，一见如故的朋友，2位花甲艺人+2位少年艺人，一起趣旅行，他们会遇到什么样的事情？真实呈现旅行风貌

programme.title: 灌篮高手第13集
programme.desc: 日本漫画家井上雄彦以高中篮球为题材的漫画和动画作品，故事叙述一名国中时期便创下50次失恋纪录的著名坏学生 ─ 樱木花道，直到进入湘北高中，因为对同校女同学 ─ 赤木晴子产生好感，受到她的鼓励后，樱木决定加入篮球队，从此展开了他的篮球生涯...而湘北高中篮球队，有著第一中锋赤木以及明星球员流川枫，另外刚出院的后卫宫城和神射手三井也陆续归队，再加上自称为天才篮球手的樱木花道的加入，这五个人将合力一起进军神奈川区篮球代表队的对抗赛，并打入四强，之后更和四强中的海南、陵南、翔阳3校争夺全国大赛的代表权。过程不仅精采刺激，内容更是扣人心弦，充分表现出高中篮球选手不屈不挠且努力奋斗的精神！同时球队队友之间

programme.title: 罪后真相
programme.desc: 七年前谋杀女友入狱的新秀球星张正义（陈昊森 饰），挟持过气名嘴刘立民（张孝全 饰）逃狱，在新闻渲染下引爆全民关注。刘立民紧蹭这波流量，在自己频道宣布要重查此案，但随著调查深入发现包括张正义的姊姊、被杀害的女友、集团富二代，甚至刘立民自己的亡妻都涉入其中。此时，豁出去的张正义绑架他的女儿真真（方郁婷 饰），要求刘立民交出真相……究竟当年是谁痛下杀手？听来的答案，你相信吗？

programme.title: 洪兴仔之江湖大风暴
programme.desc: (1996)打仔洪兴，四仔东星是一句江湖上流传已久的话。洪兴的老大洪胜与子洪飞(梁朝伟)父子不和已多年，因当年洪胜为救帮中兄弟舍弃了妻女的性命，飞对此一直耿耿于怀。小春(陈小春)乃阿B手下，向来开杀时声音大，胆子却很小，但他是飞的崇拜者，一次小春在与东星的厮斗中被东星帮少主阿宝和垃圾追杀，幸好飞经过救下小春。小春遇到偶像十分兴奋，在一次赛车中把自己的妹妹小彤(李若彤)介绍给飞认识。彤是一家报馆的记者，聪明活泼，且对江湖上的事情非常好奇，因此对飞非常感兴趣，在交往的过程中逐渐两人产生了感情。在洪胜金盆洗手的当晚，东星帮众人到场挑衅，要求洪胜交出曾打伤阿宝的小春，正好飞前来澄清了事实，东星的人灰溜

programme.title: 金派特务
programme.desc: 根据线报，大量走私枪枝即将流入韩国，菜鸟特务流茶熙（李善彬 饰）被指派前往韩国进行机密调查，为确保任务顺利，进而寻求国情局的「优秀」卧底协助，却阴错阳差遇上笨手笨脚又贪财的私家侦探禹手罕（金英光 饰）。两人联手调查，不仅零默契且漏洞百出，还让相关人证都莫名「被消失」，甚至被当成头号嫌疑犯！究竟这两个超「母汤」特务，能不能保全性命，并顺利完成任务呢？

programme.title: 临时劫案
programme.desc: 两个颓废中年难兄难弟慕容辉、笠水计划抢劫，却意外遇到真正悍匪梅蓝天，阴差阳错间三人临时组队打劫赃款，不料钱款早已被捷足先登，一时间匪徒各怀鬼胎，互相吞并，与此同时女警探姜姐也将三人锁定，枪战、抢钱一触即发，临时劫案谁生谁死谁破案。

programme.title: 西游.降魔篇
programme.desc: 这是个妖魔横行的世界，百姓苦不堪言。年轻的驱魔人玄奘以“舍小我，成大我”的大无畏精神，历尽艰难险阻，依次收服水妖、猪妖，以及妖王之王-孙悟空，且收他们为徒，并用“爱”将他们感化，而玄奘自己在这段惊险万分的过程中，也终于领悟到了“大爱”的真意。为救天下苍生于水火，为赎还自己的罪恶，师徒四人义无反顾的踏上了“下地狱”般的西行取经之路……

programme.title: 扫毒3-人在天涯
programme.desc: 国际贩毒集团毒枭康素差一直带著手下张建行等人从事毒品交易，新加入集团的成员欧志远也因一次意外，与两人建立了过命交情，三人情同手足。康素差在香港的贩毒生意突然被警方查获，他带著团队逃到金三角发展，积极笼络当地的土皇帝戴金荣，计划两人联手扩大势力，让自己东山再起，...

programme.title: 无名指
programme.desc: 本剧聚焦在一个家庭中有了罹患罕见疾病的女儿，虽然女儿打破医生的看法，从只有2年的生命活到了20岁，女儿存活的喜悦已被天天面临的沉重压力及无止尽的付出取代，逼得照顾者深感无奈又无力。

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第198集
programme.desc: 跨世代的伙伴，一见如故的朋友，2位花甲艺人+2位少年艺人，一起趣旅行，他们会遇到什么样的事情？真实呈现旅行风貌

programme.title: 灌篮高手第15集
programme.desc: 日本漫画家井上雄彦以高中篮球为题材的漫画和动画作品，故事叙述一名国中时期便创下50次失恋纪录的著名坏学生 ─ 樱木花道，直到进入湘北高中，因为对同校女同学 ─ 赤木晴子产生好感，受到她的鼓励后，樱木决定加入篮球队，从此展开了他的篮球生涯...而湘北高中篮球队，有著第一中锋赤木以及明星球员流川枫，另外刚出院的后卫宫城和神射手三井也陆续归队，再加上自称为天才篮球手的樱木花道的加入，这五个人将合力一起进军神奈川区篮球代表队的对抗赛，并打入四强，之后更和四强中的海南、陵南、翔阳3校争夺全国大赛的代表权。过程不仅精采刺激，内容更是扣人心弦，充分表现出高中篮球选手不屈不挠且努力奋斗的精神！同时球队队友之间
